    def get_obs(self, cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"), seconds: float = 0.0,
                video_fps: int = 10, include_depth: bool = False, video: str = "frames") -> Result:

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive controller for one Meta-World peg-unplug-side episode.
+
+The process owns the single Robot client. Send JSON commands on stdin:
+  {"op":"obs"}
+  {"op":"hold","seconds":1.0}
+  {"op":"move","actions":[[dx,dy,dz,grip],...],"dt":0.0125}
+Each response and its images are saved under /app/output/episode.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/episode")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+cameras = list(spec.get("cameras", []))
+print(json.dumps({"spec": spec}, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+
+
+def dump(result, tag):
+    directory = OUT / tag
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, frame in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.asarray(frame, dtype=np.uint8)).save(directory / f"{cam}.png")
+    for cam, frame in result.depth.items():
+        np.save(directory / f"{cam}_depth.npy", frame)
+    if result.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(directory / "proprio.npy", result.proprio)
+    (directory / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2, default=str))
+
+
+obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+dump(obs, "000_initial")
+print(json.dumps({"initial_meta": obs.meta, "initial_proprio": obs.meta.get("proprio")}, default=str), flush=True)
+
+index = 1
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        command = json.loads(line)
+        op = command.get("op", "")
+        tag = f"{index:03d}_{op or 'unknown'}"
+        if op == "obs":
+            result = r.get_obs(cameras=command.get("cameras", cameras), include_depth=command.get("depth", True), video="frames")
+        elif op == "hold":
+            result = r.get_obs(cameras=command.get("cameras", cameras), seconds=float(command["seconds"]),
+                               include_depth=command.get("depth", False), video="frames")
+        elif op == "move":
+            actions = np.asarray(command["actions"], dtype=np.float64)
+            result = r.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=float(command.get("dt", spec["control_dt"])),
+                              cameras=command.get("cameras", cameras), video="frames",
+                              include_depth=command.get("depth", False), note=command.get("note", ""))
+        elif op == "quit":
+            print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "quit": True}), flush=True)
+            break
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown op {op!r}")
+        dump(result, tag)
+        print(json.dumps({"tag": tag, "meta": result.meta, "proprio": result.proprio.tolist() if result.proprio is not None else None,
+                          "task": command.get("task")}, default=str), flush=True)
+        index += 1
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
